verdict.rationale: Mollie documents two scope-reducing integrations: Mollie Components/Mollie JS, which add card-holder data fields to your own checkout "in a way that is fully PCI-DSS SAQ-A compliant," and Mollie-hosted checkout pages, where the customer completes payment off your servers. Together these deliver the core story of keeping card data off merchant systems. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the tokenization mechanism (card token flow), independent or hands-on corroboration of the SAQ-A scope reduction.
